text:
Iris (CS): Heads-up  Siren Labs overdrew expected credits overnight. QBR on Wed, our forecast moved +36%. Need a short mitigation plan + one-slide ask.
Noah (FinOps): On it. Which flows drove it? embeddings or chat?
Sonia (Onboarding): Bulk transcript ingest + aggressive re-embed schedule. They also set `embed.dim=1024` in a migration.
Eli (Solutions Eng): Saw the deploy. Re-embeds retried immediately on error, which amplified requests. Also they enabled high-temp sampling on chat pilots.
BudgetBot: :warning: Project SIR-13 usage at 83% of monthly credits.
Noah (FinOps): Back-of-envelope extra monthly spend if unmitigated ~ $13k. Quick mitigations: pause re-embeds, flip to `embed-512-quant`, enable dedupe/caching, and apply temporary soft quota. Which is fastest?
Sonia (Onboarding): Pause is immediate. Model flip is a console patch and takes minutes. Dedupe needs a pipeline change but proxy caching is fast to enable.
Iris (CS): I'll tell the customer we're pausing re-embeds and are scheduling a 30m ops call. Need a clear ask: credits buffer vs 2-week Dedicated trial. Thoughts?
Noah (FinOps): Recommend proposing primary = 2-week Dedicated micro pool (demonstrates predictable throughput) and fallback = one-time 20% credits buffer tied to adoption milestones. I'll include unit economics on the slide.
Eli (Solutions Eng): Tech playbook (paste to Ops):
```
# pause job
POST /v1/projects/SIR-13/jobs/reembed/pause

# quick config patch to lower-dim model
PATCH /v1/projects/SIR-13/config
{ "embedding_model": "embed-512-quant", "embedding_dim": 512 }

# enable proxy-level prefix cache (fast)
proxy.enable_cache(prefix_key=true, ttl=72h)

# soft quota example
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/projects/SIR-13/quota" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"soft_limit_pct":60, "hard_limit_pct":90}'
```
Sonia (Onboarding): Paused re-embeds at 09:18 PT. Requeues held and retries disabled.
Iris (CS): For the QBR slide: current vs projected spend, estimated reduction per mitigation, and the ask options. Noah, can you draft numbers?
Noah (FinOps): Yes. Estimated reductions: model flip -> ~60% compute drop; caching + dedupe -> +18%; throttling -> extra ~10%. Combined ~78% potential reduction. With Dedicated micro pool, unit cost and latency stabilize which is great for renewal. I'll draft slide in 90m.
Eli (Solutions Eng): Small runbook snippet for their engineers to apply immediately (paste into customer note):
```
# throttle example (pseudo)
batcher.set_concurrency(6)
batcher.set_rate_limit(120/s)

# prefer embed-512-quant for bulk jobs
config.embedding_model = "embed-512-quant"
```
Iris (CS): Also add a renewal-risk note: unexpected spend is a top concern for them. Propose credits buffer only as a conditional concession and emphasize the Dedicated trial as the long-term fix.
BudgetBot: :white_check_mark: Incident logged: SIR-cost-surge assigned to #customer-success.
Sonia (Onboarding): Confirmed no further re-embeds until we talk to the customer.
Iris (CS): Action items: Noah finalize slide (ETA 90m), Eli add appendix with per-route metrics, Sonia keep imports paused, Iris draft customer note and book ops call.
Noah (FinOps): Adding renewal-risk flag: medium-high. I'll include recommended commit thresholds for Dedicated trial and the credits smoothing option in the deck.
Iris (CS): Thanks team. Will share customer note here in 30m for quick edits. We'll present mitigations + trial ask in the QBR and tie any credit concession to clear technical milestones. :thumbsup:
